sources.title: Best Object Detection Models 2026: RF-DETR, YOLOv12 & Beyond
sources.snippet: Object detection powers applications from autonomous vehicles to production line monitoring, and the model landscape keeps moving: transformer architectures now hold the accuracy-latency frontier, attention mechanisms have reworked the YOLO line, and zero-shot models detect objects from text prompts alone. This guide covers the best object detection models, how they benchmark, and how to run them.

sources.title: Building your own Object Detector from Scratch with Tensorflow
sources.snippet: In this story, we covered the basics of building a toy object detector from scratch using TensorFlow. We aimed to illustrate the challenges and concepts behind object detectors and provide some understanding of how this technology works.
